title: Localization of a prescribed contravariant biduality
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, C an R-linear preadditive category, t in R, U:C^op to C, and F an additive contravariant functor on the raw ScalarLocalization(R,C,t) of def-weil-linear-scalar-localization. Suppose the objects of F are the localized U objects and F sends every scalar pure tensor a tensor f to a tensor U(f^op), as an HEq with the prescribed endpoints. An integral natural isomorphism e:Id_C ≅ U.rightOp followed by U then gives a natural isomorphism b:Id_Loc ≅ F.rightOp followed by F. Every component of b is HEq to the localization of the corresponding component of e.

proof.text: Apply the object equation twice and the pure-tensor map equation twice. These give exactly the object and arrow specifications of the localized integral double dual.

Apply the normalized natural-isomorphism localization theorem to the identity and double-dual functors and the given integral biduality. This fixes all components, not just an unspecified equivalence.

theorem biduality
    {R : Type r} [CommRing R] {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    [Preadditive C] [Linear R C] (t : R) (U : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ C)
    (F : (ScalarLocalization R C t)ᵒᵖ ⥤ ScalarLocalization R C t) [F.Additive]
    (ho : ∀ K : ScalarLocalization R C t,
      F.obj (op K) = (localization R C t).obj (U.obj (op K.obj)))
    (hm : ∀ (K M : C) (f : K ⟶ M) (c : Localization.Away t),
      HEq (F.map (Quiver.Hom.op (c ⊗ₜ[R] f : mk K ⟶ mk M)))
        (c ⊗ₜ[R] U.map f.op))
    (e : 𝟭 C ≅ U.rightOp ⋙ U) :
    ∃ b : 𝟭 (ScalarLocalization R C t) ≅ F.rightOp ⋙ F,
      ∀ K : ScalarLocalization R C t,
        HEq (b.hom.app K) ((localization R C t).map (e.hom.app K.obj))
